# SocialSignIn

## Props

| Name | Type | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | boolean | Optional. An enclosing form may require consent or another prerequisite first. |
| exclude | string | Optional. Every provider but this one (an installation&#39;s password step, whose HQ account was already ruled out). |
| hint | string | Optional. The email the person typed, which HQ&#39;s sign-in opens on (`login_hint`). |
| next | string | Optional. Where to go once signed in: a same-site path, or &#39;&#39; for the account&#39;s own home. |
| only | string | Optional. Only this provider&#39;s button (the sign-up page offering a found HQ account). |
| phone | boolean | Optional. The phone&#39;s screens: their heights, type and spacing. |
| remember | boolean | Optional. Keep the session past this visit (the login page&#39;s &quot;Keep me logged in&quot;). |
| role | string | Optional. The sign-up page&#39;s &quot;I coach&quot;: the role an account this creates is made with. |
| signup | boolean | Optional. The sign-up page: &quot;or sign up with email&quot; under the buttons. |
